source_snapshot.procedure: GET all 11 named HGX firmware-inventory Redfish members for 100 cycles.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC functional, no stress-related SEL/OS errors, correct firmware information each cycle; 720-minute machine scope.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; loops only BMC_0 and discards payloads.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restores 11x100 matrix, secure credentials, payload/status/latency and health correlation but leaves project values Pending.

old_problem: Prior review held Pending for secure Redfish/TLS configuration, expected per-member fields, volatile-field policy, pacing/timeouts/latency limits and health/log oracle.
disposition_reason: Redfish GET semantics and the exact 11 resources/100 cycles are explicit and non-mutating. Missing credentials, member values and timing limits are runtime project configuration; the review can be resolved with a strict parameterized oracle that preserves the full 720-minute stress scope under ED-14 and never reduces it to a single-endpoint smoke loop.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row154, same-row AI fields and history2540; preserved variant 4ee... distinct from same-code row152 NIC counters.
Retained all 11 literal resources for all 100 numbered cycles and the 720-minute scope.
Required status, latency and canonical payload per each of 1,100 requests plus pre/post BMC,SEL and OS evidence.
Removed literal password, insecure TLS, payload discard, restart and automatic retry; no requests or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: Prove every specified HGX firmware-inventory resource remains correct and the BMC remains healthy throughout the full 100-cycle/720-minute read-only load.
required_package: curl or approved Redfish client with secure secret injection and trusted TLS policy
Runtime BMC identity and exact 11-member availability
Signed expected Id/Name/Version/Status matrix and allowed volatile fields
100-cycle schedule spanning the approved 720-minute scope, request timeout/latency/error aborts
Synchronized BMC responsiveness, SEL and OS log sources plus pinned Script revision
test_case.test_command: Capture baseline JSON/health/logs; across the approved 720-minute schedule execute 100 numbered cycles over the exact 11-member list using secure TLS/authentication, persisting cycle/member/status/latency/body for all 1,100 GETs; compare canonical fields each time, stop on defined instability, then re-query all members and correlate complete post-run health/logs without clearing evidence.
test_case.expected_result: All 1,100 requests satisfy approved HTTP and latency limits; every canonical member field matches the signed inventory matrix in every cycle; no member disappears/stales/swaps, BMC remains responsive, and no new stress-attributable SEL/OS critical error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete 100x11 evidence over the full approved duration, zero unapproved canonical mismatch and all health/error limits satisfied. One endpoint only, discarded bodies, shortened smoke duration, unauthorized retry, auth/HTTP/timeout/latency failure, stale/wrong firmware or new critical error fails.
safety_gate: Never embed/log the literal password; use secure secret injection and approved TLS trust.
Bound concurrency, pacing and timeout to the signed 720-minute load profile.
Persist every failure/body; do not clear SEL/OS logs.
Stop on instability and do not reset/restart/retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Variant identity, BMC/Redfish/certificate and client/Script versions
Pre/post BMC responsiveness, SEL and OS log correlation
Abort/recovery record if any and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The workload is read-only. On service instability stop new requests, preserve all evidence and use only the owner-approved BMC recovery after review; never restart or rerun automatically.
